tagline: Drone-style video from photos you already have
_note: domain is canonical and appears in captions and on-page text. short_domain is a redirect used ONLY for QR codes and texted links: it encodes at QR version 3 (29 modules) against version 5 (37) for the canonical URL, so the printed square is ~22% denser and scans from further. Both point at the same site. Changing either here updates every disclosure URL, QR and caption on the next build.

payments._note: Paste each SKU's Stripe Payment Link URL here and rebuild. A SKU with an empty link renders its email path instead of a dead Buy button -- see business/09-store.md for how to create them. Nothing here is secret: Payment Links are public URLs and carry no key, which is the whole reason a static site can take money.

_service_note: Where the self-serve app is deployed, e.g. https://app.iflythroughit.com or /app behind a reverse proxy. When set, every Buy button routes into the upload-first flow instead of straight to Stripe -- which is the point: the customer's photographs are checked BEFORE they are charged. Leave empty until the service is actually live; the buttons then fall back to Payment Links, and to email after that.
